cause: Four unchanged protected worktree files use CRLF while their immutable Git blobs use LF. The first packet incorrectly used worktree raw hashes for every managed source.
correction: For the232 managed source files use the existing source_manifest UTF-8-sig/universal-newline identity, preserving EOF LF count. For all original streams, Registry and other audit evidence continue to require raw-byte SHA256. The verifier binds policy to the fixed source list.
auxiliary_file_write: One patch-tool write to the audit verifier was rejected; atomic write_changed completed the same intended edit. No calculation source or protected file was modified.
